title: Straylight Control Plane audit record (v1)
description: Codex's independent audit verdict, bound to an exact head SHA and posted EXTERNALLY (PR comment / lane event) — never committed into the audited PR, because committing it changes the audited target (lesson of PR #116, ADR-050 §5.3). Executable validator: .straylight/lib/validate.mjs#validateAuditRecord.

audited_head_sha.description: The exact head SHA the verdict binds to. An ACCEPT is valid only while the PR head still equals this SHA; any head move invalidates it.

complete_diff_reviewed.description: Must be true: confirmation the complete base-to-head diff was reviewed, not a sample.

changed_files.description: Changed-file list, or a single-element digest entry of the form 'digest:<algo>:<hex>' over the sorted file list.

audit_committed_in_pr.description: PR #116 lesson: an audit committed into the audited PR changes the audited target and invalidates itself. The validator rejects true.

retryable.description: Only meaningful with CANNOT_AUDIT: true routes back to ready-for-codex within the retry budget; otherwise blocked.

audit_comment_ref.description: URL or id of the externally posted audit comment.
